body: Update: the shared workspace task tool now accepts worker=codex|cursor (default Codex), persists the choice in its task brief, selects matching preflight/launch settings, and reports the worker in status. Deterministic tests cover provider launch settings, managed registry dispatch, Cursor questions, and out-of-scope permission approval. TypeScript check and deterministic policy/provider tests pass. The live authenticated Cursor contract remains opt-in and unrun. The claim succeeded after setting PLANTOOL_HOME to the writable session temp directory; the earlier claim-lock error is obsolete.
